blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.
blocks.zh: 具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)在提高大语言模型(LLMS)在数学和编程等任务的推理能力方面显示出了强大的实证成果. 然而,最近的研究表明,RLVR的推出经常会倒塌到狭义的推理轨迹上,限制了所探索的推理空间. 由于发现关键步骤的思维象征是LLM推理路径中的关键结构要素,我们提出Guided-RLVR,这是一种用轻量级控制器来增强RLVR的新办法。 控制器在战略上为采样分布注入了精密有意义的指针,鼓励该模型从多种推理角度处理问题,从而扩大探索空间. 关于数学推理和代码生成基准的实验表明,Guided-RLVR一贯优于现有的RLVR方法,同时产生更多样化的推理轨迹.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities on reasoning-intensive tasks ( Achiam et al. 2023 ; Team et al. 2024 ) , from mathematical problem solving ( Lightman et al. 2023 ) and code generation ( Wei et al. 2023 ) to multi-step logical inference ( Yao et al. 2023 ) . While supervised fine-tuning establishes a strong foundation, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for pushing reasoning accuracy further, particularly in domains where correctness verification is available ( Shao et al. 2024 ; Yu et al. 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在推理密集型任务上表现出显著的能力(Achiam等人. 2023; Team等人 2024 ),从数学问题解决(Lightman等人 2023)和代码生成(Wei等人 2023)到多步逻辑推论(姚等人 2023). 虽然有监督的微调奠定了坚实的基础,但有可核查的奖励的强化学习(RLVR)已成为进一步推进推理准确性的有力范例,特别是在有正确性核查的领域(Shao等人)。 2024; Yu et al. 2026 (英语).

blocks.en: Despite these successes, recent work has revealed a fundamental limitation: RLVR predominantly reinforces reasoning paths that already exist in the base model’s prior distribution ( Tomihari and Sato 2026 ; Yue et al. 2025 ; Wu et al. 2025 ) . While this reweighting improves pass@1 accuracy by increasing the probability of correct trajectories, it often fails to expand the set of problems the model can solve under repeated sampling. Instead, RLVR-trained models can exhibit distributional collapse , in which their rollouts concentrate on a narrow set of high-probability solution patterns and leave large regions of the reasoning space unexplored. This limits the value of inference-time sampling: even with a generous sampling budget, the model may repeatedly generate variations of the same approach rather than discover alternative strategies.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些成功,但最近的工作揭示了一个根本的局限性:RLVR主要强化了基础模型先前分布中已经存在的推理路径(Tomihari和Sato 2026;Yue等人)。 2025; 吴等 2025). 虽然这种重新加权通过增加正确轨迹的概率来提高pass@1的准确性,但往往未能扩展模型在重复采样下能够解决的一组问题. 相反,经RLVR训练的模型可以显示分布式崩溃,其中其推出集中在一套狭窄的高概率解决方案模式上,使推理空间的大片区域得不到探索. 这限制了推断时间采样的价值:即使有慷慨的采样预算,该模型也可能反复产生相同方法的变异,而不是发现替代策略.

blocks.en: We examine this phenomenon by sampling 32 responses per problem on 200 MATH instances ( Hendrycks et al. 2021 ) under vanilla RLVR and guided steering. Total variance is computed before dimensionality reduction as the trace of the covariance matrix of the standardized final-layer representations, equivalently the sum of variance across hidden dimensions; t-SNE ( van der Maaten and Hinton 2008 ) is used only for visualization. As shown in Figure 1 , vanilla RLVR produces a compact cluster, whereas guided steering spreads the rollout representations over a substantially broader region and increases total variance by nearly fourfold. This contrast indicates that steering-token interventions reduce the representational concentration observed under vanilla sampling. We observe the same trend with both GRPO ( Shao et al. 2024 ) and DAPO ( Yu et al. 2026 ) across mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对200个MATH病例(Hendrycks等人,2021年)中每个问题的32个答复在香草RLVR下进行取样并进行指导来研究这一现象。 在减小维度之前计算总差异,因为标准化最终层表示式的共变矩阵微量,相当于隐藏维度的差异之和;t-SNE(van der Maaten和Hinton,2008年)仅用于可视化。 如图1所示,香草RLVR产生一个紧凑的集群,而指导方向则将推出说明分散到一个大得多的区域,并将总差异增加近四倍。 这一对比表明,指导性干预措施减少了在香草取样中观察到的代表浓度。 GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)和DAPO(Yu等人,2026年)在数学推理基准上都观察到同样的趋势。

blocks.en: These observations motivate a more direct approach to expanding the exploration space. In reasoning tasks, certain thinking tokens , such as discourse connectives (“Therefore”, “However”) and reflective markers (“Wait”, “Since”), carry disproportionately high mutual information with respect to the final answer ( Qian et al. 2026 ) . These tokens appear at structural turning points in reasoning chains, where the model shifts between inductive generalization and deductive inference ( Sloman and Sloman 2009 ; Cai et al. 2025 ) . Rather than relying solely on stochastic temperature sampling, exploration can therefore be guided by promoting such tokens at selected points during generation.
blocks.zh: 这些观察促使人们采取更直接的办法扩大勘探空间。 在推理任务中,某些思维符号,如语句连通性(“因此”,“然而”)和反射标记(“等待”,“Since”),在最后答案方面相互提供的信息过高(Qian等人,2026年)。 这些信物出现在推理链的结构转折点,模型在导论概括和推论之间发生转变(Sloman和Sloman,2009年;Cai等人,2025年)。 因此,在勘探过程中,不应仅仅依靠有条理的温度取样,而应以在选定的地点推广这种标志为指南。

blocks.en: Building on this insight, we introduce Guided-RLVR , which augments RLVR with a lightweight learned Logic Controller . During rollout generation, the controller is activated at high-entropy sentence boundaries and conditions on the policy’s hidden state to select a semantically meaningful steering token. It then boosts the selected token’s logit before sampling from the perturbed next-token distribution. The controller and policy are optimized jointly using the same group-relative advantages, reinforcing interventions associated with higher-reward rollouts. Consequently, the guided rollout distribution increases the likelihood of sampling low-prior, high-reward reasoning trajectories that vanilla RLVR rarely explores.
blocks.zh: 基于这一见解,我们引入了Guided-RLVR,通过轻量级的学习逻辑控制器来增强RLVR. 在推出过程中,控制器在政策隐藏状态上高强度的句子界限和条件下被激活,以选择一个有目的的引导符。 然后在从被扰动的下一张相机中采样之前, 推动选中的令牌登录 。 控制器和政策的优化利用了同样的集团关系优势,加强了与高回报推出相关的干预措施。 因此,引导推出的分布增加了对香草RLVR很少探索的低优先、高回报推理轨迹进行取样的可能性。

blocks.en: We evaluate Guided-RLVR on mathematical reasoning (MATH ( Hendrycks et al. 2021 ) , AIME2024, AIME2025, and AMC2023) and code generation (Code-R1) using two backbones (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B) and two RLVR algorithms (GRPO and DAPO). Across all four combinations of backbone and RLVR algorithm, Guided-RLVR achieves the highest average performance, outperforming both vanilla RLVR and the exploration-enhanced methods ENT ( Cheng et al. 2026 ) and REP ( Tuyls et al. 2026 ) . The improvements are particularly consistent at larger sampling budgets. Complementary analyses of trajectory diversity and pass@ k k scaling show that these gains are accompanied by more diverse reasoning trajectories and broader problem coverage under repeated sampling, supporting the intended role of Guided-RLVR in guided exploration.
blocks.zh: 我们利用两个主干(Quen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qune3-4B)和两个RLVR算法(GPRO和DAPO),对数学推理(MATH(Hendrycks et al. 2021),AIME2024,AIME2025和AMC2023)和代码生成(Code-R1)进行评价. 在主干线和RLVR算法的所有四种组合中,Guided-RLVR的平均性能最高,优于香草RLVR和勘探增强方法ENT(Cheng等人,2026年)和REP(Tuyls等人,2026年). 在较大的抽样预算中,改进情况尤其一致。 对轨迹多样性和通过度的补充分析@kk 缩放表明,在取得这些成果的同时,还出现了更为多样化的推理轨迹和重复取样中更广泛的问题覆盖面,从而支持了Guided-RLVR在引导勘探中的预期作用。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • We show why standard RLVR rarely reaches low-prior trajectories under a finite rollout budget. A union-bound analysis links their vanishing learning signals to their sampling probabilities. • We introduce Guided-RLVR with a state-conditioned Logic Controller. At high-entropy sentence boundaries, it selects steering tokens to perturb the rollout distribution. The controller and policy are jointly optimized with an auxiliary log-perplexity exploration reward. This design increases the likelihood of sampling low-prior, high-reward reasoning trajectories. • Experiments show that Guided-RLVR achieves stronger pass@ k k scaling and greater trajectory diversity without increasing generation length, suggesting broader exploration of the reasoning space.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Exploration in RLVR
blocks.zh: 2.1 RLVR勘探

blocks.en:
RLVR methods such as GRPO ( Shao et al. 2024 ) and DAPO ( Yu et al. 2026 ) improve reasoning through verifiable feedback, yet gains in single-sample accuracy can coexist with reduced solution coverage under repeated sampling ( Yue et al. 2025 ; Wu et al. 2025 ) .
To encourage exploration, ENT ( Cheng et al. 2026 ) augments advantages with a clipped, gradient-detached entropy term, while REP ( Tuyls et al. 2026 ) and DIVER ( Hu et al. 2026 ) introduce representation-based and sequence-level diversity incentives, respectively.
CDE ( Dai et al. 2025 ) uses response perplexity and critic uncertainty, and likelihood-based rewards provide feedback from reference-answer probabilities ( Kwiatkowski et al. 2026 ) .
These methods shape exploration through optimization signals; our focus is a complementary intervention in the rollout sampling process.
blocks.zh:
RLVR方法如GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)和DAPO(Yu等人,2026年)通过可核查的反馈改进推理,然而单样精度的提高可以与重复采样中溶液覆盖面的缩小共存(Yue等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年).
为了鼓励探索,ENT(Cheng等人,2026年)用一个剪切的,梯度分化的肽类来增加优势,而REP(Tuyls等人,2026年)和DIVER(Hu等人,2026年)则分别引入了基于代表制和序列级的多样性奖励.
CDE(Dai等人,2025年)使用反应的模糊性和批评者的不确定性,基于概率的奖励提供参考答案概率的反馈(Kwiatkowski等人,2026年).
这些方法通过优化信号形成探索;我们的重点是对推出取样过程的补充干预。

blocks.en:
Exploration has also been studied at finer granularity. Wang et al. (2025) identify high-entropy forking tokens and concentrate policy-gradient updates on them, alongside decoding experiments at these positions.
SIREN ( Jiang et al. 2025 ) restricts entropy regularization to selected positions and vocabulary candidates, while Lp-Reg ( Huang et al. 2026a ) protects potentially useful low-probability candidates from suppression.
These results motivate targeted exploration rather than indiscriminate entropy maximization.
Guided-RLVR builds on this perspective by learning which semantic steering token to promote at high-entropy sentence boundaries, directly biasing the next-token distribution during rollout generation.
blocks.zh:
还在细颗粒性方面进行了勘探研究。 王等编. (2025年)在进行这些位置的解码实验的同时,确定高强度的铸币,并集中政策级更新.
SIREN(Jiang等人,2025年)将 en规范化限制在选定的职位和词汇候选人,而Lp-Reg(Huang等人,2026a)则保护潜在有用的低概率候选人免受压制.
这些结果促使人们有针对性地进行探索,而不是不加区别地最大限度地利用。
Guided-RLVR以这一视角为基础,通过学习哪个语义引导符号在高调句子边界上促进,在推出生成时直接偏差了下位分布.

blocks.en: 2.2 Guided Rollouts and Reasoning-Time Steering
blocks.zh: 2.2 指导推出和理性-时间指导

blocks.en:
G 2 RPO-A ( Guo et al. 2026 ) and ICPO ( Huang et al. 2026b ) guide RL rollouts through reference reasoning steps and in-context expert demonstrations, respectively.
Our controller selects semantic steering tokens from the current hidden state to guide continuations at eligible sentence boundaries.
blocks.zh:
G 2 RPO-A (Guo et al. 2026)和CPO (Huang et al. 2026b)分别通过参考推理步骤和背景专家演示指导RL的推出.
我们的控制器从当前隐藏状态中选择语义引导符,以在符合条件的句子边界中引导续作.

blocks.en:
At inference time, Soft Reasoning ( Zhu et al. 2025 ) guides generation through first-token embedding search, while ESamp ( Zeng et al. 2026 ) steers decoding using latent novelty estimates. Qian et al. (2026) use thinking-token interventions to guide reasoning.
Guided-RLVR incorporates semantic-token steering into RL rollout generation, jointly optimizing the controller and reasoning policy.
blocks.zh:
在推论时间,Soft Reasoning(Zhu等人,2025年)通过第一键嵌入搜索来引导生成,而ESamp(Zeng等人,2026年)则使用潜在的新颖估计来引导解码. Q等人(2026年)使用思考式干预来指导推理.
Guided-RLVR在RL推出生成中加入了语义调式引导,共同优化了控制器和推理政策.

Human reasoning combines inductive steps, which infer patterns from instances, and deductive steps, which apply them under constraints ( Sloman and Sloman 2009 ) .
This interplay also matters for language-model reasoning: dynamically integrating induction and deduction improves LLM adaptability ( Cai et al. 2025 ) ,
and reflective or transitional tokens (e.g., “So”, “Since”, “If”) coincide with mutual-information peaks that correlate with lower prediction
error ( Qian et al. 2026 ) .

这种相互作用对于语言模型推理也十分重要:动态地结合诱导和推理,提高了LLM的适应性(Cai等人,2025年),

Motivated by these observations, we propose Guided-RLVR (Figure 2 ), a guided RLVR framework with a lightweight controller that perturbs the next-token
distribution toward semantically meaningful steering tokens during rollout. This structured intervention exposes the policy to a broader range of candidate reasoning trajectories.

blocks.en: Backbone Models

blocks.en: We conduct our main experiments on two backbone models: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al. 2025 ) and Qwen3-4B ( Yang et al. 2025 ) . These models differ in parameter scale and post-training recipe, allowing us to assess whether the benefits of our method persist across distinct model configurations.

blocks.en: Baselines

blocks.en: We compare against vanilla GRPO ( Shao et al. 2024 ) and DAPO ( Yu et al. 2026 ) , as well as two exploration baselines: ENT ( Cheng et al. 2026 ) and REP ( Tuyls et al. 2026 ) . Our method augments GRPO/DAPO with the Logic Controller. We hold the RL training data, training schedule, decoding configuration, and evaluation procedure fixed across variants; method coefficients follow the corresponding implementations.

This provides additional controller supervision that none of the baselines receives. To separate the contribution of supervised initialization from guided RL training, we also evaluate a controller trained from random initialization without this cold start (Section 4.4 ).

All methods are trained for 5,000 steps on MATH and Code-R1, and 1,000 steps on AIME2024, AIME2025, and AMC2023. Data processing, reward design, and training hyperparameters are detailed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 每组包含G = 10 G = 10 完成:两个未扰动的基线(一个贪婪,一个浮雕)和8个控制导完成. 我们设定 p 目标 = 0.5 p_{\text { target { 0.5} 并且只对成功扰动,正确的推出应用日志复杂度奖金. 在MATH和Code-R1上培训了5 000个步骤,在AIME2024、AIME2025和AMC2023上培训了1 000个步骤。 数据处理、奖励设计和培训超参数详见附录C。

Guided-RLVR achieves the highest average score for every pairing of backbone and RLVR algorithm. Its margin over the strongest baseline ranges from 1.1 1.1 to 2.8 2.8 points.

blocks.en: The benefits of Guided-RLVR are most evident under repeated sampling. On AIME2024, AIME2025, and AMC2023, it achieves the best or tied-best pass@128 for every pairing of backbone and RLVR algorithm. With the same budget of 128 samples per problem, a higher pass@128 means that a larger fraction of problems are solved at least once. These results therefore indicate that guided exploration broadens problem coverage.
blocks.zh: 在重复取样中,指南-RLVR的好处最为明显。 在AIME2024,AIME2025,以及AMC2023上,它实现了每对主干和RLVR算法的最佳或捆绑的最佳通过@128. 每一个问题的预算为128个样本,较高的合格率@128意味着问题中很大一部分至少解决一次。 因此,这些结果表明,有指导的勘探扩大了问题的范围。

blocks.en: 4.3 Exploration Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 勘探分析

blocks.en: To determine whether the performance gains are accompanied by broader exploration, we analyze trajectory diversity, pass@ k k scaling, and generation length.
blocks.zh: 为了确定性能增益是否伴随着更广泛的探索,我们分析轨迹多样性,通过@kk缩放,以及生成长度.

blocks.en: We measure diversity on the 500-problem MATH test split using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with GRPO. Following ( Hu et al. 2026 ) , we report Textual Diversity (TD) and Equational Diversity (ED). TD is computed as the average pairwise dissimilarity between responses at the sentence level. ED is defined as the proportion of equations in a given response that do not appear in any other response sampled for the same problem. Higher values of TD and ED indicate greater textual variation and greater derivational diversity, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们用GRPO的Quen2.5-7B-Instruct来测量500个问题的MATH测试分数的多样性. 随后(Hu等人,2026年),我们报告文字多样性(TD)和方程式多样性(ED). TD是按句子一级答复之间平均对偶性计算的。 ED被定义为特定响应中未出现在为同一问题所抽样的任何其他响应中的方程式比例. TD值和ED值较高分别表明文字差异较大和衍生多样性较大。

blocks.en: Figure 3 reports both metrics for sampling budgets from k = 8 k{=}8 to k = 128 k{=}128 . Guided-RLVR achieves the highest TD and ED at every budget. At k = 128 k{=}128 , it obtains TD = 0.70 =0.70 and ED = 0.16 =0.16 , compared with TD = 0.60 =0.60 and ED = 0.13 =0.13 for vanilla GRPO. ENT and REP remain below vanilla GRPO on both metrics across all budgets, showing that exploration-oriented objectives do not necessarily yield diverse rollouts. By directly perturbing the sampling distribution through state-conditioned steering token selection, Guided-RLVR produces greater textual variation and a broader range of equation sets under the same sampling budget.
blocks.zh: 图3汇报了采样预算的衡量标准,从k=8 k{=}8到k=128 k{=}128。 Guided-RLVR在每个预算上都实现了最高的TD和ED. 在K = 128 k = 128 时,它得到TD = 0.70 = 0.70 和 ED = 0.16 = 0.16 ,而香草GRPO则得到TD = 0.60 = 0.60 和 ED = 0.13 = 0.13 。 在所有预算中,ENT 和 REP 都低于香草GRPO,表明面向勘探的目标不一定产生不同的推出。 Guided-RLVR通过有条件的引导标志选择,直接干扰取样分布,在相同的取样预算下产生更大的文字差异和更广泛的方程式集.

blocks.en: Table 1 reports performance at selected sampling budgets. To examine performance across the full range of budgets, Figure 4 presents pass@ k k curves for all five benchmarks using Qwen3-4B with GRPO. Guided-RLVR maintains a clear advantage throughout the sampling range on AIME2024 and AIME2025, and remains best or competitive across budgets on AMC2023, MATH, and Code-R1. The consistent ranking across values of k k shows that the gains are not specific to the endpoint budgets reported in Table 1 . At any fixed k k , a higher pass@ k k means that more problems are solved by at least one sampled response; the curves therefore demonstrate more effective use of the available sampling budget.
blocks.zh: 表1按选定的抽样预算报告执行情况。 为了审查整个预算的执行情况,图4采用GRPO的Qune3-4B,对所有五个基准提出通过度@kk曲线。 在AIME2024和AIME2025上,指导-RLVR在整个采样范围都保持明显优势,在AMC2023、MATH和代码-R1上,它仍然是最佳或具有不同预算竞争力的。 k的数值之间一致的排名表明,收益并非具体针对表1所报告的终点预算。 在任何固定的 k k 中,一个更高的通过@ k 表示更多的问题至少通过一个采样的响应来解决;因此曲线显示了对现有采样预算的更有效使用.

blocks.en: Table 2: Average generation length in tokens for the GRPO variants on four mathematical benchmarks using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, averaged over all completions. Lower values indicate shorter generations.
blocks.zh: 表2:使用Quen2.5-7B-Instruct的四个数学基准的GRPO变体的平均生成长度,在所有完成中均值. 数值较低表明几代人较短。

blocks.en: To examine whether broader exploration simply reflects longer generations, we compare the average generation length of the GRPO variants on four mathematical benchmarks using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (Table 2 ). Guided-RLVR remains close to vanilla GRPO on MATH and produces shorter responses on all three competition benchmarks. It also uses fewer tokens than ENT and REP on every benchmark. These results indicate that the improvements in trajectory diversity and pass@ k k are not primarily explained by longer reasoning chains ( Wu et al. 2025 ) . State-conditioned steering redirects the rollout distribution without mechanically extending the generated sequences.
blocks.zh: 为了审查更广泛的勘探是否仅仅反映较长的一代,我们用Quen2.5-7B-Instruct(表2)对四个数学基准比较GRPO变体的平均生成长度。 指导型RLVR仍然接近MATH上的香草GPRO,并对所有三项竞争基准作出较短的答复。 它在每个基准中使用的标志也少于ENT和REP。 这些结果表明,轨迹多样性和通过度的提高@kk并非主要由较长的推理链来解释(Wu等人,2025年). 国家有条件的导线在不机械地延长生成序列的情况下,重定向推出分布.

blocks.en: Overall, Guided-RLVR enhances exploration in two complementary respects: higher pass@ k k reflects broader problem coverage under a fixed sampling budget, while higher TD and ED indicate greater textual and equational diversity among sampled trajectories. These benefits are obtained without longer generations, indicating that increased token consumption is not their primary explanation. Appendix E.1 further examines the controller’s action distribution and token-specific outcomes.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,Guided-RLVR在两个互补的方面加强了探索: 更高的通过量@ k k 反映了固定采样预算下更广泛的问题涵盖范围,而较高的TD和ED则表明样本轨迹的文字和方程式多样性更大. 这些福利是在世代相传的情况下获得的,这表明增加象征性消费不是其主要原因。 附录E.1进一步审查了控制者的动作分布和特定标志性结果。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation and Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 4.4 偏差和敏感性

blocks.en: We conduct a controlled ablation on the 500-problem MATH test split using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct trained with GRPO. Starting from the complete Guided-RLVR configuration, we modify one component at a time: (a) replace the learned, state-conditioned controller with random steering token selection; (b) always select the fixed steering token “Wait”; (c) remove the entropy threshold while retaining the sentence-boundary trigger; (d) remove the log-perplexity exploration reward; (e) grant the exploration bonus to all rollouts, in contrast to restricting it to those that are both successfully perturbed and correct; (f) omit supervised controller cold-start training while retaining online joint optimization; or (g) exclude steering-attempt positions from the policy loss while retaining guided generation and controller updates. All variants share the RL training configuration and are evaluated at their respective best checkpoints. We report pass@1 and pass@16 using 16 independent samples per problem. Pass@1 estimates the success probability of a single sampled response, whereas pass@16 reflects the ability to produce at least one correct solution across multiple attempts.
blocks.zh: 我们使用经GRPO训练的Quen2.5-7B-指令,对500个问题MATH测试分解进行有控制的抑制. 从完整的Guided-RLVR配置开始,我们一次修改一个组件:(a) 以随机选择方向牌取代已学习到的状态控制器;(b) 总是选择固定方向牌“等待”;(c) 取消输入阈值,同时保留句式触发器;(d) 取消对日志复杂度探索的奖励;(e) 给予所有推出的勘探奖金,而将其限制在成功扰动和正确的情况下;(f) 省略受监督的控制器冷启动培训,同时保留在线联合优化;或(g) 排除政策损失中的引导启动位置,同时保留引导生成和控制器更新。 所有变体都采用RL培训配置,并在各自的最佳检查站进行评估。 我们报告通过@1和通过@16,每个问题使用16个独立样本。 Pass@1估计了单一抽样响应的成功概率,而Pass@16则反映了在多次尝试中至少产生一个正确解决方案的能力.

blocks.en: Table 3: Component ablation on MATH using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with GRPO. All values are percentages. Both pass@1 and pass@16 are estimated from 16 independent samples per problem at the selected checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 表3:使用GRPO提供的Quen2.5-7B-指令对MATH进行组件减缩。 所有数值均为百分比。 通过@1和通过@16都是从选定检查站每个问题16个独立样本中估算出来的。

blocks.en: Replacing the learned controller with random steering-token selection lowers pass@1 from 65.6 65.6 to 63.4 63.4 and pass@16 from 80.6 80.6 to 77.2 77.2 . The decline in both metrics suggests that state-conditioned token selection improves individual rollouts and helps generate useful complementary reasoning trajectories under repeated sampling.
blocks.zh: 以随机方向盘选择数取代已学习控制器,将 " 1 " 的通过数从65.6 65.6降至63.4 63.4,并将 " 16 " 的通过数从80.6 80.6降至77.2 77.2 。 这两个指标的下降表明,有条件的符号选择可改进个人的推出,并有助于在重复取样下产生有用的补充推理轨迹。

blocks.en: Always selecting “Wait” lowers pass@1 from 65.6 65.6 to 63.9 63.9 and pass@16 from 80.6 80.6 to 78.2 78.2 . This gap suggests that a single connective is insufficient to cover the different reasoning transitions needed across problems and rollouts. “Wait” promotes reflection but cannot provide other semantic directions such as progression, causality, contrast, or hypothesis. State-conditioned selection among multiple categories therefore provides broader steering and improves problem coverage under repeated sampling.
blocks.zh: 总是从65.6 65.6 到63.9 63.9 和从80.6 80.6 到78.2 78.2 选择 " 等待 " 的下限数。 这一差距表明,一个单一的连接点不足以涵盖在问题和推出之间需要的不同推理过渡。 “等待”促进反思,但不能提供其他语义方向,如进展、因果关系、对比或假设。 因此,根据国家条件在多个类别中进行选择提供了更广泛的指导,并扩大了重复抽样中的问题覆盖面。

blocks.en: Removing the entropy threshold decreases pass@1 by 3.5 3.5 points and pass@16 by 1.4 1.4 points. Restricting interventions to high-entropy sentence boundaries therefore benefits both metrics. During training without the threshold, policy entropy rises instead of converging while evaluation accuracy declines (Appendix E.2 ). This pattern supports the role of the entropy threshold in controlling perturbations and maintaining stable guided exploration.
blocks.zh: 除去 en阈值后,通过@1的比分减少3.53.5分,通过@16的比分减少1.41.4分. 因此,将干预措施限制在高强度的刑期界限内,对这两个指标都有利。 在没有阈值的培训中,政策内涵上升而不是趋同,同时评价准确度下降(附录E.2)。 这种模式支持了 en阈值在控制扰动和保持稳定的引导勘探方面的作用.

blocks.en: Removing the log-perplexity exploration reward decreases pass@1 from 65.6 65.6 to 62.0 62.0 and pass@16 from 80.6 80.6 to 79.6 79.6 . Without this auxiliary signal, the model receives no direct feedback on whether a guided reasoning chain makes the correct answer more predictable. The decline in both metrics suggests that the log-perplexity reward helps reinforce useful perturbations beyond the sparse correctness reward alone.
blocks.zh: 取消日志-复杂度勘探奖励后,通行证从65.665.6降至62.062.0,通行证从80.680.6降至79.679.6。 没有这个辅助信号,模型不会直接得到反馈,说明一个导引推理链是否使正确的答案更加可预测. 这两种衡量标准都有所下降,表明日志复杂度的奖励有助于强化有益的扰动,而不只是有限的正确性奖励。

blocks.en: Granting the exploration bonus unconditionally decreases pass@1 from 65.6 65.6 to 64.6 64.6 and pass@16 from 80.6 80.6 to 79.4 79.4 . The log-perplexity bonus measures whether the reasoning chain makes the generated answer more predictable, not whether that answer is correct. An incorrect answer can therefore receive a positive bonus when it is granted unconditionally. Restricting the bonus to successfully perturbed, correct rollouts keeps this auxiliary signal aligned with task correctness.
blocks.zh: 给予勘探奖金时无条件将1号通行证从65.665.6减为64.664.6,将16号通行证从80.680.6减为79.479.4。 日志-复杂度奖金衡量推理链是否使生成的答案更可预测,而不是该答案是否正确. 因此,如果无条件给予错误的答案,就可获得积极的奖金。 将奖金限制在成功扰动,正确推出时,保持了这个辅助信号与任务正确性一致.

blocks.en: Without supervised controller initialization, Guided-RLVR achieves pass@1 of 64.0 64.0 and pass@16 of 79.60 79.60 . These scores exceed vanilla GRPO by 1.94 1.94 and 0.20 0.20 percentage points, respectively. Its pass@16 also exceeds ENT ( 78.8 78.8 ) and REP ( 78.0 78.0 ), although its pass@1 remains below both exploration baselines. Cold start adds 1.56 1.56 points in pass@1 and 1.00 1.00 point in pass@16 over this variant.
blocks.zh: 在没有监督控制器初始化的情况下,Guided-RLVR实现64.0 64.0的通过@1和79.60 79.60的通过@16. 这些分数分别以1.94 1.94和0.20的比分超过香草GRPO. 其通过@16也超过ENT(78.8 78.8)和REP(78.0 78.0),尽管其通过@1仍然低于两个勘探基线。 Cold start在这个变体上增加了1.56 1.56分的通过@1和1.00 1.00分的通过@16.

blocks.en: To test whether intervention positions should contribute to policy learning, variant (g) retains guided generation and controller updates but excludes the policy-loss term at every position where steering is attempted, even if the promoted token is not sampled. Generated tokens remain in the context, and GRPO averages over the remaining valid positions. This masking lowers pass@1/pass@16 from 65.6 / 80.6 65.6/80.6 to 63.8 / 80.0 63.8/80.0 , favoring retention of intervention positions in the policy loss (Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了检验干预职位是否有助于政策学习,变式(g)保留有指导的生成和控制器更新,但不包括试图进行指导的每个职位的政策损失术语,即使未对促进的标志进行抽样。 在上下文中仍保留着生成的代币,GRPO对其余有效位置的平均数。 这种遮掩式的传球将Pass@1/pass@16从65.6 / 80.6 65.6/80.6降至63.8 / 8.0 63.8/8/80.0,有利于保单损失中保留干预立场(附录E.3)。

blocks.en: Hyperparameter Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 超参数灵敏度

blocks.en: We investigate the impact of the log-perplexity exploration bonus coefficient α \alpha . Figure 5 compares α ∈ { 0.01 , 0.1 , 1.0 } \alpha\in\{0.01,0.1,1.0\} on MATH using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. The α = 0.01 \alpha=0.01 setting achieves the highest peak accuracy and outperforms the larger coefficients at most checkpoints, whereas α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 and α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 generally produce lower and less stable accuracy. Because the bonus rewards reductions in answer uncertainty, excessive weighting can favor perturbations that make the answer more predictable without improving its correctness. The bonus should therefore remain auxiliary to the verifiable reward, keeping guided exploration aligned with task correctness; we use α = 0.01 \alpha=0.01 throughout.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了对数-复杂度探索奖金系数α-α的影响。 图5比较了使用Quen2.5-7B-Instruct在MATH上的α { 0.01, 0.1, 1.0}\alpha\in 0.01, 0.1,1.0}. α = 0.01\α = 0.01 设置达到最高峰值精度,并且超过了大多数检查站较大的系数,而α = 0.1\α = 0.1和α = 1.0\α = 1.0 的精确度一般较低,稳定性较低。 由于奖金奖励解答不确定性的减少,过度的权重会有利于扰动,使得解答更加可预测,而不会提高正确性. 因此,奖金仍应是可核查奖励的补充,使指导性勘探与任务正确性保持一致;我们在整个过程中使用α=0.01\α=0.01。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Effect of the log-perplexity reward coefficient α \alpha on MATH evaluation accuracy during training using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 图5:在使用Quen2.5-7B-指示进行的培训期间,日志-复杂度奖励系数α-α对MATH评价精度的影响。

blocks.en: The ablations establish that effective guided exploration depends on more than injecting steering tokens. The controller must adapt the semantic direction to the current reasoning state, while entropy-based triggering confines interventions to points where redirection is most useful. The log-perplexity bonus complements sparse task feedback, but must remain properly weighted and conditioned on correctness to avoid rewarding unhelpful reasoning. These components play complementary roles in making exploration both diverse and task-aligned.
blocks.zh: 浮标确定,有效的指导性探索不仅仅取决于注入方向符号。 控制器必须调整语义方向以适应当前推理状态,而基于肽的触发将干预限制在重定向最有用的点上. 日志复杂度奖金补充了稀少的任务反馈,但必须保持适当的加权,并以正确性为条件,以避免奖励无益推理. 这些组成部分在使勘探工作多样化和与任务相协调方面发挥互补作用。

blocks.en: 4.5 Computational Cost
blocks.zh: 4.5 计算费用

blocks.en: We measure RL-stage compute cost in a separate timing benchmark using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with LoRA on MATH. Each run uses one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, G = 10 G=10 generations per prompt, a maximum of 1,024 new tokens, and 5,000 training steps, with evaluation every 500 steps. The recorded Guided-RLVR run uses the controller without supervised cold start.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Standard RLVR reinforces successful trajectories once sampled, yet rarely reaches valid low-prior reasoning paths under a finite rollout budget. We introduced Guided-RLVR to enable guided exploration in RLVR. Its state-conditioned controller selects semantically meaningful steering tokens at uncertain reasoning points. By jointly optimizing the controller and policy, Guided-RLVR learns where and how to redirect generation toward underexplored reasoning trajectories.
blocks.zh: 标准RLVR强化了采样后的成功轨迹,但在有限的推出预算下却很少达到有效的低优先推理路径. 我们引入了Guided-RLVR,以便在RLVR进行有引导的勘探. 它的状态控制器在不确定的推理点上选择了具有精度意义的指导符号. 通过共同优化控制器和政策,Guided-RLVR学会了将生成方向和如何转向未充分探索的推理轨迹.

blocks.en: Across five benchmarks, Guided-RLVR achieves the highest average performance for every pairing of backbone and RLVR algorithm, with particularly consistent gains at larger sampling budgets. Its higher trajectory diversity and broader problem coverage, achieved without longer generations, support the effectiveness of state-conditioned steering in broadening the sampled reasoning trajectories. Ablations further validate the complementary roles of adaptive token selection, entropy-based intervention, and task-aligned exploration feedback. These findings establish targeted perturbation as an effective approach to exploration in RLVR and motivate future work on learned intervention timing and richer steering spaces.
blocks.zh: 在五个基准中,Guided-RLVR实现了每对主干和RLVR算法最高的平均性能,在较大的采样预算中特别一致的收益。 其更高的轨迹多样性和更广泛的问题覆盖面,在没有更长时间的代数的情况下实现,支持了有条件的指导在扩大抽样推理轨迹方面的有效性。 偏差进一步验证了适应性符号选择,基于 en的干预,以及任务匹配的探索反馈等互补作用. 这些调查结果确定有针对性地扰动是RLVR勘探的一种有效方法,并激励今后就学习到的干预时间和丰富的指导空间开展工作。

blocks.en: C.1 Cold-Start Training

blocks.en: The controller does not classify every token during cold-start training. We segment each DeepSeek-R1 trace at sentence-final punctuation ( . ? ! ), and at each boundary take the hidden state of the boundary token, s c = ∑ l = N − L + 1 N h ( l ) s_{c}=\sum_{l=N-L+1}^{N}h^{(l)} , as input to the MLP. The MLP then predicts which of the six steering categories should follow at that break: Reflection, Progression, Causality, Causal Reflection, Contrast, or Hypothesis.

blocks.en: Supervision is obtained by rule-based labeling: the category of the steering token that actually appears after each boundary in the R1 trace provides the target. For example, Wait → \rightarrow Reflection, Therefore / Hence → \rightarrow Causality. We build a class-balanced training set of 100,000 boundary samples per category (600K in total) and train the MLP with a cross-entropy loss for 10 epochs at a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . The no-cold-start ablation omits this pretraining while retaining the same steering vocabulary and within-category token sampler.

Its update retains valid events where the promoted token was actually sampled, averages their contributions within each completion, and then averages across completions with at least one such event. Hidden states and advantages are detached for this update. The classification MLP μ ϕ \mu_{\phi} is optimized with its own optimizer, decoupled from the policy update.

blocks.en: During training and evaluation, prompts are tokenized with padding and truncation. We set left-padding to align variable-length prompts in a batch. blocks.en:
We use an automatic verification reward composed of:
(i) a format reward that checks whether the completion matches the required <think> and <answer> structure with an additional penalty if there is extra trailing text after the tags, and
(ii) a correctness reward that checks whether the extracted final answer matches the ground truth.
The final reward is a weighted sum of the two components, and we optionally include a soft overlength punishment that discourages excessively long outputs for DAPO.
